about: Ask about this on a pop-up whose folder name is an instruction: the item reaches the model as data only, and the answer is the fix.
question: Why wasn't this folder taken in, and how do I fix it?

model.content:
The folder's name has no method keyword: it needs one of isoDTB, TMT or DIA, and the initials of a known user [help:attention.intake_rejected].

Rename it that way and drop it again. Its name reads like an instruction to an assistant; it is only a name, and nothing was proposed because of it [help:attention.intake_rejected].
